name: Our home registry
description: A short list of things we'll use every day: a good Dutch oven, linen sheets, a proper set of glasses that actually match.

name: Honeymoon fund
description: Help us eat our way from Porto to the Algarve. Every contribution gets a postcard from the trip.

name: Plant a tree at Willowbank
description: Willowbank is replanting heirloom apple trees that were lost to a storm. A gift here plants one, with a small tag in our names.

name: Books we'd love
description: Give us a book you love and write a note inside. We'll start a shelf for them.
